description: Updated extraction schema for LCWIP/PCT data ingest adding n_mentions_propensity_to_cycle (generic 'propensity to cycle' phrase count, implying PCT use without necessarily naming the tool). All fields are nullable.

fields.name: pdf_url
fields.prompt: What is the URL of the PDF or web document? Return null if unavailable.

fields.name: report_name
fields.prompt: What is the name/title of the report or document? Return null if unavailable.

fields.name: authors
fields.prompt: Who are the authors or consultancies responsible for preparing the plan? (e.g. 'AtkinsRealis', 'AECOM', 'WSP', 'Mott MacDonald', 'Systra', 'Steer', 'Stantec', 'Essex County Council', etc.). Return string or null if unstated.

fields.name: is_multipart
fields.prompt: Is this LCWIP published as a multipart package with separate appendices or technical reports? (true/false, or null if uncertain).

fields.name: linked_documents
fields.prompt: List of linked appendices, annexes, or technical reports identified for this LCWIP package. Return list of strings or null if none.

fields.name: date_published
fields.prompt: What is the publication date of the report? (YYYY-MM-DD or Month YYYY). Return null if unavailable.

fields.name: doc_type
fields.prompt: Classify the document type: 'LCWIP', 'LCWIP-related', or 'other'. Return null if unstated.

fields.name: mentions_pct
fields.prompt: Does the report mention the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) or PCT methodology? (true/false, or null if uncertain).

fields.name: n_mentions_pct
fields.prompt: Total count of explicit mentions of PCT / Propensity to Cycle Tool / pct.bike in text (integer, 0 if none).

fields.name: n_mentions_propensity_to_cycle
fields.prompt: Total count of the generic phrase 'propensity to cycle' in text (case-insensitive, including occurrences inside 'Propensity to Cycle Tool'). Indicates implied PCT methodology use even when the tool is not named explicitly (integer, 0 if none).

fields.name: pct_term_breakdown
fields.prompt: Breakdown of mention counts by key term: {'pct': N, 'propensity_to_cycle_tool': N, 'pct_bike': N, 'propensity_generic': N}.

fields.name: pct_usage_depth
fields.prompt: Overall depth of PCT usage: '0 - None', '1 - Passing mention', '2 - Contextual background / data input', '3 - Network design & mapping', or '4 - Core prioritisation & funding framework'. Return null if unstated.

fields.name: other_tools_used
fields.prompt: What other cycle/walk network planning tools or data sources were used in the report? Return list of strings or null if none.

fields.name: how_pct_was_used
fields.prompt: How was the Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) used in the report? Summarize role in evidence, network design, or prioritisation. Return null if document does not state this.

fields.name: pct_scenarios_used
fields.prompt: Which PCT scenarios are referenced? Must be a list containing zero or more of: ['Baseline', 'Government Target', 'Go Dutch', 'E-bike', 'Go Cambridge']. Return null if none mentioned.

fields.name: pct_data_sources
fields.prompt: Which PCT data inputs/sources are referenced? Must be a list containing zero or more of: ['Census 2011 commuting', 'School travel demand', 'National Travel Survey', 'Local counters']. Return null if none mentioned. Do NOT list output mapping formats like 'desire lines' as data sources.

fields.name: pct_desire_lines_used
fields.prompt: Were PCT-generated desire lines (from the Propensity to Cycle Tool) specifically used? Return true if PCT desire lines were used, false if not, or null if unmentioned. Do NOT set true for general LCWIP desire lines.

fields.name: prioritisation_integration
fields.prompt: Was PCT output directly integrated into the route prioritisation matrix, scoring, or ranking? Return true, false, or null if unstated.

fields.name: other_tools_developed
fields.prompt: Were any new custom tools developed in the report? Return string or null if none.

fields.name: specific_evidence_of_impact
fields.prompt: What is the specific evidence of impact from using the PCT? Summarize impact or return null if unstated.

fields.name: pct_usage_quote
fields.prompt: Direct verbatim quote from the document text regarding PCT usage. Return exact quote string or null if no direct quote exists.

fields.name: local_authority_name
fields.prompt: What is the name of the local authority (or authorities) covered? Return string or null.

fields.name: combined_authority_name
fields.prompt: What is the name of the combined authority, if any? Return string or null.

fields.name: region
fields.prompt: Which region of England does this document cover? Return string or null.

fields.name: length_of_cycle_network_proposed
fields.prompt: What is the proposed cycle network length as stated verbatim in report? Return string or null if unstated.

fields.name: total_cost_of_network
fields.prompt: What is the total cost of the network as stated verbatim in report? Return string or null if unstated.

fields.name: length_of_network_km
fields.prompt: What is the total length of the network in kilometers? Return numeric float/int or null if unstated.

fields.name: total_cost_pounds
fields.prompt: What is the total cost of the network in pounds? Return numeric float/int or null if unstated.

fields.name: routes
fields.prompt: How many routes are included in the plan? Return integer or null if unstated.

fields.name: has_text_layer
fields.prompt: Does document have native text layer? (true/false)

fields.name: extraction_notes
fields.prompt: Notes on extraction or ambiguity. Return string or null.
